name: Complaint authority graph enrichment
description: Enriches a complaint draft with authority graph data: regulatory agency hierarchies, statutory citation graphs, and jurisdiction chains. Uses the GraphRAG ontology pipeline to surface which authorities govern each claim element.

text.description: The complaint draft text to enrich with authority graph data.

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code to include state authority chains.

authority_nodes.description: Authority graph nodes (agencies, statutes, regulations) related to the complaint.
